content: fcntl.flock(fd, LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) raises BlockingIOError (OSError subclass, errno EACCES or EAGAIN) when held elsewhere; LOCK_UN releases; kernel releases the lock when the fd is closed or the owning process dies (verified locally: child acquired immediately after holder SIGKILL). flock locks are per-open-file-description (two separate opens in one process are independent locks). fcntl is Availability: Unix, not WASI — Windows needs a different mechanism (msvcrt.locking) or graceful degradation. Locally verified: try-lock blocks with errno 35 (EAGAIN), wait-loop with deadline acquires ~0.5s after holder release.
